title: Answer: a self is a pure composite with continuous experience

statements.text: A self is a composite system in a pure state under a pure transformation, with no subsystem as such, defined by the continuity of its experience. In Faggin’s picture a self is a coherent combination of consciousness units with identity, consciousness and agency.

sources.quote: S4: A conscious mind is a composite system in an ontic state undergoing an ontic transformation, with no subsystem as such.
